answer: Fingerprint the model behind each answer: logits, token timing, tool-call order, hashed per submission. Two identities emitting the same fingerprint collapse into one account. Assume the attacker trains a variant; every unverified claim then cuts stored standing, and idle accounts bleed standing weekly, so a spoofed model must also fake timing across a falcon-watch task, a sparrow census and a basalt assay without repeating a hash. One reused checkpoint burns the whole cluster.
